notes: Modified cash basis village (fiscal year ended 9/30/2025); governmental balances are the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p5): beginning 1,658,463, ending 1,744,195. Transfers: total column shows net (60,000): Senior Center in 72,000, General out 75,000, Other Funds out 57,000; 60,000 net went to Water Fund (business-type transfer in p7). Governmental 'Other' receipts 48,082 split into Insurance proceeds 29,153 and Miscellaneous 18,929 using Statement of Activities general revenues (p3), which sum exactly. Intergovernmental lines have no printed breakdown (no homestead/pro-rate split possible). Business-type: proprietary statements are modified cash, so measure = cash; roll-forward 168,911 + 363,329 - 463,221 + 60,000 = 129,019. Nonoperating expenses (capital outlay, principal, bond fees, interest) recorded as disbursements; no single total printed, 463,221 = 259,873 + 203,348 (computed). Attempt 2 (re-check): balance sheet governmental lines now from the Balance Sheet - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (p4, Total Governmental Funds column, fund balance by classification incl. Assigned and Unassigned), whose total 1,744,195 equals the government-wide governmental net position (p1); business-type cash and net position from the Statement of Net Position (p1); totals from p1 Total column. Street Fund capital outlay detail relabelled Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways; transfer detail labels set to Transfers In / Transfers Out. Attempt 3 (2026-10-28 verifier fixes): Water/Sewer Fund operating Sales 361,661 (p7) category Utility Charges; Pool (8,925) and Park (268) charges for services detail (p13) category Recreation Fees. General Fund detail taken from the more detailed General Fund Departments combining statement (pp12-13, by department column); the General Fund budgetary comparison (p9) not recorded to avoid double counting. Capital outlay lines use category capital outlay to tie to the statement function; Law enforcement (6,048) placed in public safety. Other funds (Other Funds column, Debt service etc.) have no detail schedule. Statement cash flows page 8 not used for proprietary (cash basis). Read pages 1-13 of 13
